title: Forward-connected RRT completes one of four original cases.
summary: Independent replay confirms chicane_left completes at 8 seconds with both checkpoints. Three cases exhaust their transition allocations. The unchanged four-case qualification remains contradicted; source comparison stays closed.
boundary: One seed per exposed case, unchanged total budgets. Full scalar masks cover 76 returned states; unselected background labels and native tree/RNG remain producer evidence. This does not establish source recovery, transfer or superiority.
